src='''def transform(grid):
    # Split at the constant divider; keep right panel background and mark overlap
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and grid[0][c] not in (0,))
    left=[row[:sep] for row in grid]; right=[row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    # dominant color of right panel is its background
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark=next((x for x in range(10) if x != bg), 3)
    return [[mark if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] == bg else bg for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
